The addition of `OozieLauncherOutputFormat` and `OozieLauncherOutputCommitter` in `JavaActionExecutor.java` supports the changes made in `LauncherMapperHelper.java`, where the output format and committer are set for the job configuration. This cohesive change addresses the bug identified in OOZIE-2623, ensuring that Oozie can utilize a dummy output format effectively.
